relations.statement: NFReach is not a computable predicate on Nat.
Halts M c iff there exist w, w' with Rep c w, Reach (Rules M) w w', and Irreducible (Rules M) w'.

lemmas.statement: The predicate n |-> start word of n reaches an irreducible word under Rules M0 is not a computable predicate on Nat.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem target : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n : ℕ => NFReach n) := GenesisComputation.Universal.nfReach_not_computable

near_misses.claim: The map n |-> startWord n is computable, so non-computability transfers to any code encoding.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: COMP-C7c: computability of the input-to-start-word map is not proved, so it cannot be assumed.
